messages:
incident-bot: PAGER: High error rate detected on streaming-decode us-west-1. Symptom: repeated GPU OOMs causing streaming connections to drop. Alert threshold breached at 04:07 UTC.
Nina Park: I see it on dashboards — decode-gpu OOM count jumped from 2/hr -> 90 in 6m. Several pods reporting failed allocations for KV cache and decode buffers.
Owen (oncall): I'm on it. Any recent deploys?
Jules Martin: small config push 03:58 to adjust streaming buffer pool sizes, but it passed CI. Might be an interaction with older client payloads.
Owen (oncall): grabbing logs. Example: `2026-03-15T04:06:21Z decode-pod-12 ERROR cuda.cpp:289 cudaMalloc failed: out of memory (requested 2684354560)` then `drop_request id=xyz reason=oom`.
Owen (oncall): snippet:
```
[04:06:21] decode-pod-12 ERROR cuda.cpp:289 cudaMalloc failed: out of memory (2684354560)
[04:06:21] decode-pod-12 ERROR kv_cache.cpp:142 reserve failed for 2GB
[04:06:21] controller WARN dropping request id=xyz policy=oom
```
Nina Park: customer impact: 4 customers reported partial stream drops; two on free-tier, two on dedicated. Overall streaming 5xx percent up to 8% for a 5-min window.
infra-bot: autoscaler: scaling events suppressed due to rapid flapping; recommend manual intervention.
Jules Martin: hypothesis: buffer pool change increased per-request GPU residency for long-running streams; combined with a few runaway sessions (no max_tokens) -> memory blowout.
Owen (oncall): mitigations: 1) temporary server-side cap: set `max_tokens=1500` and `stream_chunk_size=256` global for the fleet; 2) enable early-signal detection to abort streams that exceed token/sec threshold; 3) route heavy streaming requests to cpu-fallback group if GPU mem >85%.
Owen (oncall): applying hotfix: `rdctl apply -f - <<EOF
fleet: us-west-1-decode
overrides:
  runtime.max_tokens: 1500
  runtime.stream_chunk_size: 256
  runtime.stream_rate_limit: 200tok/s
EOF`
eng-telemetry: pushed new alert rule: `oom_count > 5 in 5m per-pod` -> page oncall.
Nina Park: also applying request-level clamp for suspicious client_agents: `X-Client-Id` patterns older-than-2023 will be limited to 30 concurrent streams.
Jules Martin: started targeted cordon of 3 pods that showed repeated OOM traces to prevent noisy neighbour effect.
Owen (oncall): running controlled TTL eviction of large KV caches on warm pods: `rdctl exec decode-pod-* -- rdutil scrub-kv --threshold 0.8` -> observed immediate mem reclaim on 5 pods.
Owen (oncall): enabling fallback route: `route-policy add heavy-streams -> rdx-cpu-fallback` (non-streaming response shape). This reduces GPU pressure but increases latency. Communicating to customers in parallel.
infra-bot: manual cordon complete for pods: decode-pod-12, decode-pod-19, decode-pod-21.
Nina Park: initial mitigation shows OOMs down ~90% on updated pods. Error rate for streaming endpoints down from 8% -> 1.3%.
Owen (oncall): taking handoff notes: leave hotpatch in place 60m while we validate. If stable, we'll roll the patch fleet-wide with a 10% canary.
Jules Martin: post-incident actions: 1) revert the buffer pool change and re-run perf tests with long prompt sims, 2) add CI gate to validate streaming path enforces `max_tokens` and `stream_rate_limit`, 3) add metric for per-client prompt-token distribution, 4) add structured OOM logging with `request_id`, `client_id`, `kv_reserve_bytes`.
Nina Park: comms: sent incident-initial to affected customers with mitigation steps and estimated ETA 2h for full restore.
Owen (oncall): note for postmortem: investigate why the deploy didn't trigger canary memory load tests; also why autoscaler suppressed scaling.
eng-telemetry: collecting traces and flamegraphs from affected pods, attaching to incident ticket INC-2026-321.
Owen (oncall): I'll stay on watch for 45m, then hand to next oncall. Please drop any terminal logs here.
Nina Park: thanks team — please avoid rolling back the runtime change until we have a safe plan; rolling back without tests might re-trigger OOMs. :eyes:
incident-bot: INCIDENT: mitigations applied; severity lowered to P2. Next automated update in 30m or on status change.
Owen (oncall): closing thread for now; will re-open if regression.
